verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents running shell commands in sandboxes through its SDK, with process inspection and control (blaxel-docs-17). Output logs can be retrieved in batch or streamed in real time (blaxel-docs-20), and processes can also be driven through the built-in sandbox MCP server (blaxel-docs-38). Packages can be pre-installed via Dockerfile-based sandbox images (blaxel-docs-32), and arbitrary shell access implies installing at runtime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of installing packages at runtime (e.g. apt/pip/npm inside a running sandbox), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
